description: Get detailed information about an ATProtocol lexicon schema: its definitions, authority, CID and any published documentation. Use this to understand the structure and format of XRPC methods, records, and other lexicon types.

identity.description: Optional: The identity (DID like 'did:plc:...' or handle like 'alice.bsky.social') of the authority publishing this lexicon. If not provided, the authority will be resolved via DNS.

language.description: Optional: Preferred language code (ISO 639) for localized descriptions from garden.lexicon.documentation records. If not provided, only schema descriptions are shown. Use language codes like 'en', 'pt-BR', 'ja', etc.

lexicon.description: The lexicon NSID to describe (e.g., 'app.bsky.feed.post', 'com.atproto.repo.createRecord', or 'app.bsky.actor.profile#viewBasic' for a specific fragment)

name: describe_lexicon
